name: NextXen Booking – Booking & Rental System for WooCommerce
author: nextxentech

sections.description:
NextXen Booking adds a dedicated “Rental / Booking” product type to WooCommerce, turning your store into a fully-featured booking and rental system.

Free Features:

  • Date-based (daily) rental product type
  • Product presets for accommodation, item rental, and general reservations
  • Configurable check-in/check-out, pickup/return, or custom terminology
  • Optional start and end times with configurable intervals and defaults
  • Turnaround buffers before and after bookings
  • Adult, child, and infant occupancy validation
  • Pooled room or item inventory with date-range availability
  • Per-day pricing with live price calculation
  • Interactive date range picker on the product page
  • Real-time availability check via AJAX
  • Minimum and maximum rental duration rules
  • Advance booking window and last-minute cutoff settings
  • Admin-defined blocked date ranges per product
  • Automatic date blocking when an order is placed
  • Booking dates displayed in cart, checkout, order emails, and admin order screen
  • Dedicated NextXen Booking dashboard and admin menu
  • Filterable bookings overview with direct order and product links
  • Central upcoming availability view
  • Consolidated global settings and booking-product navigation
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • Extensible via action and filter hooks

Pro Features (upgrade to NextXen Booking Pro):

  • Hourly and monthly pricing modes
  • Seasonal / dynamic date-range pricing
  • Weekend surcharge pricing
  • Tiered duration discounts (e.g. 10% off for 7+ days)
  • Person-based pricing (adults, children, infants)
  • Security deposits (fixed or percentage)
  • Late-return fee automation
  • Damage waiver / insurance add-on option
  • Named inventory items (Car #1, Car #2, …)
  • Pickup & return locations with location-based pricing
  • Resource add-ons (GPS, baby seat, extra driver, …)
  • Recurring blackout dates (e.g. every Sunday)
  • Step-by-step booking wizard
  • Request for Quote (RFQ) system with messaging
  • FullCalendar admin booking calendar (month/week/day/list views)
  • Customer order cancellation with configurable refund rules
  • Extend booking self-service from My Account
  • PDF rental agreement attached to confirmation email
  • SMS notifications (Twilio)
  • Zapier / webhook integration
  • Google Calendar two-way sync
  • iCal (.ics) export
  • Product settings export / import
  • Waitlist for fully booked dates
  • Revenue & occupancy reporting dashboard
  • WPML / Polylang support
  • Multi-vendor (Dokan / WCFM) support

Upgrade to Pro →

External Services

This plugin integrates with the following external services:

Freemius
The plugin uses the Freemius SDK to manage licensing, plugin updates, and (optionally) anonymous usage analytics. The Freemius SDK may send data to Freemius servers (https://api.freemius.com) when the plugin is activated, deactivated, or updated. This includes non-personally-identifiable technical data such as the plugin version, WordPress version, and PHP version. No data is sent without user consent during the opt-in dialog.

  • Service URL: https://freemius.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
  • Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nextxen-booking folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open NextXen Booking → Booking Products, add a product, and select the Rental / Booking product type.
  5. Use NextXen Booking → Bookings to manage bookings and Settings for global configuration.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is tested with WooCommerce 9.9 and supports WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Can I set different prices for different seasons?

Seasonal pricing is a Pro feature. The free version supports a single per-day rate.

Can customers book multiple rooms or rental units at once?

Yes. Configure the number of available units on the booking product. Availability is calculated across overlapping date ranges.

Can I use this for hotel rooms?

Yes. Select the Accommodation / Hotel preset, enable guests, configure room inventory and occupancy, and the form will use check-in, check-out, nights, rooms and guest controls.

Is it compatible with WPML?

WPML support is included in the Pro version.

Where can I get support?

Free support is available via the WordPress.org support forums. Pro customers get priority email support at https://nextxentech.com/support/.

Where is the documentation?

Full documentation is at https://nextxentech.com/docs/nextxen-booking-booking-and-rental-system-for-woocommerce/
sections.changelog:
1.5.1

  • Fixed booking snapshots being stored with order number #0 before WooCommerce assigned order and item IDs.
  • Added automatic repair for previously orphaned booking snapshots.
  • Fixed a fatal error when WooCommerce passed shipping or fee items to the booking-details callback.
  • Restored order status display for repaired booking records.
  • Updated the Extensions page with current Pro features and Freemius-powered upgrade links.
  • Hid internal booking metadata from the WooCommerce order item display.

1.5.0

  • Added monthly pricing with partial-month billing.
  • Added configurable weekend surcharges and duration discounts.
  • Added per-day adult, child, and infant pricing.
  • Added fixed or percentage security deposits.
  • Added pickup and return locations with optional location fees.
  • Added location and pricing-rule snapshots to bookings and WooCommerce order details.

1.4.0

  • Added hourly pricing for time-enabled booking products.
  • Added seasonal date-range pricing multipliers.
  • Added fixed-price optional booking add-ons.
  • Added named rooms, vehicles, and inventory with resource-specific availability.
  • Added the [nextxen_booking_search] availability-search shortcode.
  • Added inventory and add-on snapshots to booking records and WooCommerce orders.

1.3.0

  • Added optional time selection for rentals, accommodation, and general reservations.
  • Added configurable default start/end times and 15, 30, or 60-minute intervals.
  • Added before/after turnaround buffers to prevent back-to-back booking conflicts.
  • Added timezone-aware date/time validation and datetime display throughout cart, checkout, orders, emails, and booking administration.
  • Migrated booking snapshots from date-only columns to datetime storage while preserving date-only products.

1.2.0

  • Added accommodation, item-rental, and general-reservation product presets.
  • Added configurable booking terminology for dates, duration, units, and booking actions.
  • Added guest and occupancy controls for adults, children, and infants.
  • Added pooled multi-unit availability for rooms and rentable inventory.
  • Added unit-aware pricing and immutable booking-type, guest, unit, and terminology snapshots.

1.1.0

  • Added a dedicated top-level NextXen Booking admin menu and dashboard.
  • Consolidated bookings, booking products, availability, settings, extensions, and Freemius navigation.
  • Added booking status, product, and pickup-date filters with status summaries.
  • Added a central availability overview and dashboard quick actions.
  • Added a booking-management capability for administrators and shop managers.
  • Added compatibility redirects for the previous WooCommerce menu and settings URLs.
  • Added contextual help, documentation links, and responsive administration styling.

1.0.1

  • Confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.1.
  • Updated the Freemius SDK to version 2.13.4.
  • Updated Freemius licensing, trial, and admin menu configuration.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
